handoff_instructions: Re-applied the saved workflow/wip/M3-T16.patch (it already fit within per-file limits, largest file 126 changed lines) and validated it as-is; no further edits needed. Change: inbound SMS webhook handling now takes a StructuredExtractor-aware handler map. webhook-processor.ts adds createInboundSmsHandler(extractor) and exports createWebhookHandlers(extractor) (DEFAULT_WEBHOOK_HANDLERS now built from the fixture extractor via that factory); a known-employee sender with a non-empty body is routed to runFieldCaptureWorkflow(sourceCommunicationId, text, extractor) instead of getting the M2-T23 acknowledgement. handleProviderWebhook (apps/web/src/server/webhook-route.ts) gained an optional selectHandlers, resolved together with the provider adapter so a misconfigured extractor also fails closed as 503; both the sms and voice route handlers pass selectHandlers: () => createWebhookHandlers(providerRuntime().extractor). ProviderRuntime (packages/integrations/src/runtime-config.ts) gained an extractor field (FixtureStructuredExtractor in fake mode, AnthropicStructuredExtractor with a new required ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / optional ANTHROPIC_MODEL env var in live mode) plus matching runtime-config tests. jobs.ts's runBackgroundJobs now builds handlers from runtime.extractor. Added packages/workflows/test/field-capture-sms.test.ts: an integration test using FakeSmsProvider end to end through the real webhook/database path with a counting extractor stub, asserting a known employee's message drafts a time entry (no ack sent) and that redelivering the same event does not call the extractor again or draft anything new (satisfies this task's done_when). Updated existing tests/callers (call-lifecycle.test.ts, outbound.test.ts, sms-acknowledgement.test.ts) to supply the new ProviderRuntime.extractor field / assert the new field-capture routing. format:check, lint, typecheck and the full test suite (pnpm test, all packages including packages/workflows: 52/52) all pass. Next: nothing further for M3-T16; ready for review.
